purpose: Post hoc exact arithmetic explanation of national versus within-state glimepiride volume-share differences; no new inferential model. User-supplied illustrative estimates and prior v1.6 outcomes are known.
population: Same visible paired age rows,50states,2013-2024,and same glimepiride family/allSU mapping as v1.6. No suppressed age volume imputed.
notation: o,y=age groups; s=state; t=year; a_s,o/y are state age-specific SU 30-day-fill volumes divided by corresponding 50-state age total; p_s,o/y are glimepiride percent shares; q_s proportional to V_s,o*V_s,y/(V_s,o+V_s,y), normalized within year.
caveats: Geographic weights are prescription-volume shares, not beneficiary residence distributions.

E measures adding the observed published non-50-state units; R cannot be attributed exclusively to non-state units and will be audited for age-suppressed published rows plus national-vs-published-subnational total-volume discrepancy.
Share differences are nonlinear, so geographic addition effects are arithmetic, reference-dependent.
Annual within-state weighted differences are distinct from pooled2013-2024 beta4.04; pooled estimate equals annual W weighted by each year total unnormalized harmonic weight.
No causal interpretation; do not claim equal coverage of suppressed or unreported cells.
Harmonic weights are not declared approximately young-volume weights until ratios/normalized-weight distances are summarized.
validation: Independent loop check of identities and paired-weight pooled beta against v1.6; absolute numerical tolerance1e-9pp, retain full precision CSV; hash source inputs before/after.
